posts.title: In Development
posts.description: Life is not just surviving, it's a journey. From birth onward, we’re in development. Depending on our character, it could be for better or worse.

posts.title: Opinions Attract AND Repel
posts.description: When do we determine when to speak up and when to let sleeping dogs lie? When is it itching for an argument? And when is dealing with conflict honestly and productively?

posts.title: Webmaster Journey
posts.description: In the late 1990s I created a website for my Dad who was an actor, writer and director. As well as a media instructor. To promote him as a voice talent and gain students for his different classes. The early days of using Yahoo site builder eventually lead to a poor man’s Frontpage called Namo. Then in the early 2000s a friend of ours taught me about WordPress.
